flags.text: Eight shit deaths outside any detected fight after the allied Fangtooth: three to Valmont, two to Wraith.
Fangtooth went allied, then Wukong and Sparrow died at the pit and Steel on the duo lane.
A five-kill lead never became gold: 73.0k to 93.0k, and allied objective damage 3111 against 78464.
Argus did the damn work: 1115 hero damage per minute on a 504 norm, with one death.

focus.title: No deaths between fights
focus.action: While Valmont or Wraith is unseen, every ally farms within reach of a teammate, and after any objective the whole team resets together before starting the next play.

17.4.call: Two separate plays: Argus killed Countess in the allied jungle, and Valmont and Wraith scored three kills after the allied Fangtooth. Start Fangtooth only with Valmont and Wraith located.

31.5.call: Valmont razed the allied mid inhibitor, killed Sparrow on the mid lane and died to Argus seconds later; three more allied structures fell within a minute. With an inhibitor down, defend the other lanes first.

34.3.call: In the allied base, Wraith killed Sparrow and Argus killed Countess, then Wraith destroyed the Core. With every inhibitor down, all five fight beside the Core.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Ran the vision: 18 wards on an 11.9 norm. Adele still cleared 7 wards against the allied 4, so re-ward the Fangtooth pit right before each spawn.
Both Wraith deaths came on the duo lane; the second, outside any detected fight, preceded Wraith razing the allied duo outer. While Wraith is unseen, stay beside Sparrow.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Farm without damage: 10.7 CS per minute on an 8.3 norm, but 497 hero damage per minute on a 915 norm. When Steel lands a stun, follow with Piercing Shot.
Three of four deaths went to Wraith, including a duo-lane death outside any detected fight. When marked by Peekaboo!, back off until the mark fades.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Kills on Greystone, Valmont and Countess twice, and 39019 hero damage behind only Valmont. When Valmont binds an ally with Arterial Grip, break the bind with a Dread Nova stun.
The lone death, to Valmont outside any detected fight, came before an enemy Fangtooth. Only 5 wards, the fewest of all ten players: ward the river before leaving mid.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Two enemy Fangtooths and the Primal Fangtooth fell with no ally dead. 11 wards on a 7.1 norm; before each pit spawn, call contest or a tower elsewhere.
Two deaths to Valmont, then a third to Countess at the Prime pit just before enemy Orb Prime. Before any Prime attempt, wait for Steel or Murdock to arrive.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Rotated for a duo-lane kill on Wraith before the offlane opened, then razed the enemy offlane outer. After the next outer falls, call Wukong before pushing the inner.
Two deaths to Countess on the offlane, then one to Adele outside any detected fight shortly before the offlane inner fell. When Countess is unseen, hold near tower.

matchup: Duo was Steel and Sparrow against Wraith and Adele; the allied duo died zero times before minute ten, the enemy duo twice.
Wraith's five kills all landed on Sparrow and Steel.
build: Tainted Guard cuts healing for any hero landing a basic attack on Steel; Countess healed 13935.
Forticus and Tainted Guard both add physical armor; Raiment of Renewal adds health and out-of-combat regeneration, no armor.
The 57.3% winning core of Xenia, Dynamo and Gaia Greaves never made the build.
eternal: Krix raises maximum health per level; Regenerative Tissue heals after a stretch without hero damage.
Idrisil leans ahead of Krix in the Steel support field.
Regenerative Tissue with Feeding Frenzy is the best Krix pair; the Cannibalism pair run here is the most played.
augment: Heavy Metal adds bonus magical damage to Heavy Punches and Shield Bash from total physical and magical armor.
Heavy Metal leads a toss-up with Adaptive Force in the Steel support field. Sound keep.
crest: Tranquility's Grace active heals Steel and nearby heroes and grants brief damage mitigation.
Tranquility has too few games to lead; Leafsong and Rift Walkers sit tied at the top.
Tranquility evolves from Keeper Crest; Leafsong evolves from Warden Crest.
improvement: Xenia over Raiment of Renewal adds both armors and shields nearby allies, giving up raw health and regeneration.
Idrisil over Krix trades bonus health for extra armor while healthy and an emergency shield at low health.

matchup: Wraith out-damaged Sparrow 29730 to 17388 and finished with 20830 gold to 16515.
Wraith's Peekaboo! marks and reveals targets, and Knock, Knock! deals extra maximum-health damage to marked units.
All three Sparrow kills landed on Adele, first blood included.
build: Lightning Hawk, Vanquisher and Tainted Rounds match the 56.3% winning core exactly.
Tainted Rounds cuts the target's healing on basic-attack hits, useful into Adele's 9960 healing.
Terminus converts overhealing from lifesteal into a shield.
eternal: Weald fires true-damage missiles on damaging a hero at low health; Wind-Rider grants attack speed after a dash or Stealth.
Weald leads a toss-up with Thraex in the Sparrow carry field, and Forage with Wind-Rider is the best Weald pair. Sound keep.
augment: Endless Hunt resets basic ability cooldowns on takedowns and permanently adds physical penetration.
Sun Shards leans ahead of Endless Hunt in the Sparrow carry field.
crest: Liberator's Purifying Guard active cleanses all debuffs and grants a short shield.
Pacifier leads a toss-up with Liberator in the Sparrow carry field; both evolve from Sharpshooter Crest. Sound keep.
improvement: Sun Shards over Endless Hunt adds ricocheting basic attacks with reduced on-hit effects, giving up takedown cooldown resets.

matchup: Valmont and Argus each killed the other once on the mid lane; Valmont's 56224 hero damage led all ten players.
Valmont's Exsanguinate bats return to Valmont and restore health.
build: Azure Core, Entropy and Wraith Leggings match the 56.2% winning core exactly.
Tainted Scepter cuts healing on magical damage, a direct answer to the Exsanguinate return heal.
Spellbreaker's Veil blocks the next ability, and magical power rises while Veil is up.
eternal: Vesh adds a damage-over-time from ability damage on heroes; Mind Rot adds a share of current health.
Aion leads a toss-up with Vesh in the Argus midlane field; Lich with Mind Rot is the best Vesh pair. Sound keep.
augment: Infinite Obliteration gives Synaptic Obliterator projectiles infinite range, faster travel and a longer slow.
Mana Catalyst and Arcane Engine both rank ahead of Infinite Obliteration, the most played, in the Argus midlane field.
crest: Epoch's Stasis Device active puts Argus in Stasis.
Soulbearer is clearly the best Argus midlane crest; Epoch ranks second. Both evolve from Wizard Crest.
improvement: Soulbearer over Epoch trades Stasis for a shield with magical lifesteal and movement speed.
Mana Catalyst over Infinite Obliteration trades ultimate range for mana restored from hero damage.

matchup: Greystone was the jungle opponent; Greystone died once, to Argus, and never to Wukong.
Greystone's 45706 objective damage led all ten players.
Valmont scored two of the three Wukong deaths.
build: Manta Scythe deals extra basic-attack damage to minions and small monsters, a clear-speed pick.
Infernum and The Perforator are two of the 54.9% winning core; Mindrazor never made the build.
No finished item carried armor against an enemy comp with three physical damage dealers.
eternal: Lotus grants a random stat bonus on a timer and on each takedown; Early Bloom adds a level at level 12.
Lotus leads a toss-up with Demiurge and Weald in the Wukong jungle field. Sound keep.
No Lotus minor pair has enough games to rank.
augment: Masterful Mimicry adds one more max Clone and passively generates Hair stacks.
Masterful Mimicry is the only Wukong jungle augment with enough games to lead: most played, no edge claimed.
crest: Nex's Reap dash damages nearby heroes, boosted by stored Sow, and slows.
Nex has too few games to lead; Judgement and Ortus sit tied at the top of the Wukong jungle field.
Nex evolves from Assassin Crest; Judgement evolves from Champion Crest.
improvement: Mindrazor in place of Manta Scythe matches the winning core, trading clear speed for basic-attack splash damage.
Judgement over Nex adds omnivamp and healing on hero hits, giving up the Sow burst.

matchup: Countess was the lane opponent and killed Murdock twice on the offlane; Murdock never killed Countess.
Countess's Feast suppresses, and Blade Siphon restores health per target hit.
build: Tainted Rounds and Vanquisher are two of the 61.5% winning core; Lightning Hawk never made the build.
Into Countess's 13935 healing, Tainted Rounds fits the offlane matchup: each basic-attack hit applies a healing reduction.
Nuclear Rounds raises ability damage based on critical strike chance.
eternal: Taproot restores health on basic attacks; the Weald major adds true-damage missiles once a hero drops low.
Thraex is clearly the best Murdock offlane Eternal; Weald is next among Eternals with enough games.
Forage with Taproot is the best Weald pair; the run used Natural Resistance instead of Forage.
augment: Justice's Reach makes Shots Fired pierce units and adds range.
Justice's Reach leads a three-way toss-up with Sting Operation and Martial Law. Sound keep.
crest: Pacifier's Adrenalize dashes and empowers the next physical hit, more against low-health targets.
Liberator leans ahead of Pacifier in the Murdock offlane field; both evolve from Sharpshooter Crest.
improvement: Thraex over Weald is the field-backed swap: a basic-attack mark raising damage on the marked hero and cutting damage taken.
Liberator over Pacifier trades the dash and low-health burst for a full cleanse and shield.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.8s of lockdown): Countess Feast (suppress 0.75s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Adele. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 4 items of it.
Dive threat on our backline: Countess. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
We have sustain (Steel) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Windsurge engage → Cyclebreaker damage-reduction spin → clones from 84000 Hairs
ourKits.winCondition: stance-dance for damage or tankiness and overwhelm with clones
ourKits.playWith: a team that fights alongside his clones
ourKits.playAgainst: AoE clears his clones; CC him during the damage-reduction window

ourKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
ourKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
ourKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
ourKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
ourKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

ourKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
ourKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
ourKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
ourKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

ourKits.combo: Dread Nova stun → Ether Crystal push/lift → Particle Shredder channel → Synaptic Obliterator beams
ourKits.winCondition: poke from max range and zone with the crystal
ourKits.playWith: a frontline to protect his stationary channel
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Dread Nova; dive him during the immobile ult channel

enemyKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
enemyKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
enemyKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal

enemyKits.combo: Shadow Slip in → Eventide → Blade Siphon → Feast suppress ult, Haemorrhage true-damage
enemyKits.winCondition: Feast-suppress a squishy and delete them with true-damage burst
enemyKits.passive: two-ability hits apply a %max-HP true-damage bleed
enemyKits.playWith: a team to clean up after her pick
enemyKits.playAgainst: Feast is her whole engage — bait it / peel; she's fragile, punish the recast window

enemyKits.combo: Peekaboo! mark+slow → Knock, Knock! sniper → Back It Up! displacement ult
enemyKits.winCondition: land long-range snipes on marked targets and reset on takedowns
enemyKits.playWith: engage that holds a target in his sniper line
enemyKits.playAgainst: close the gap — he's weak point-blank; dodge the skillshot snipe

valmont.loadout: Vesh (Lich + Phylactery), augment Sanguine Banquet, crest Typhoon
fedBy: Hemophagia (passive): When Valmont deals damage to an Enemy with Crimson Sigil or Bloodbound causes Lilith to strike them, dealing 12/20/28/36/44/23/31/39/47 (Based on Bloodbound Level) (+15%) magical damage. The more attack speed Valmont has, the shorter the delay between strikes is. On Enemy Takedown their soul is consumed by Lilith and you restore 3/3/4/4/5/5/6/7/8/10/12/15/18/21/24/27/30/33-41 Mana (Based on Hero Level). Consuming the soul of an Enemy Hero restores 35% Maximum Mana additionally.
ultPlus: Overseer (Exalted): Enhance your Ultimate Ability: Deals 15% more damage. Heals you for 25% of the damage dealt to Heroes.
lines: Exsanguinate at top rank: 5s base, about 3.1s by the end (38% shorter) from 63 ability haste: Azure Core 10, Orion 15, Prophecy 15, Entropy 15, Typhoon 8.
7 takedowns (5 kills, 2 assists) fed: Hemophagia (passive).
Overseer (Exalted): Enhance your Ultimate Ability: Deals 15% more damage. Heals you for 25% of the damage dealt to Heroes.
Their build heals off damage: anti-heal (the Tainted items) cuts it.

Penetration: Overseer 8; against Wukong (about 58 magical armor, 50 after penetration) and Sparrow (about 47 magical armor, 39 after penetration) that is about 5% and 6% more damage (estimate: level about 17, percent penetration taken before flat).

Vesh (Eternal): Ability damage dealt to Enemy Heroes deals 7% (+0.4% a minute, about 21% by the end) of that damage as a DoT over 3s.
